title: Warmly Spiced Chicken Braise
description: A hearty, comforting chicken dish infused with the warmth of spices, inspired by traditional Portuguese cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chicken; cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add warmly spiced portuguese saffron, chicken broth, red wine, bay leaves, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil; cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Remove bay leaves; serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
